research-ethics-timeline.alt: A timeline with four stages. Before: an institutional review board, or an animal care committee for animal research, reviews and approves the plan. At the start: informed consent, where participants learn what will happen and agree; minors give assent and a parent consents. During: the right to withdraw at any time, protection from harm with risks kept minimal, and confidentiality. After: debriefing, where the true purpose is explained, including any deception. A note says that on the exam you name a safeguard the summary describes and say how the researchers applied it.
